service.name: Punjab Bhu-Naksha
service.operator: Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab / Director, Land Records, Punjab
service.localCustodianEvidence: The official Punjab viewer exposes Firozpur district, Firozpur tehsil, Firozpur Shehar kanungo and village map selectors; the Firozpur district government Punjabi site links citizens to public land-record services.
service.scope: Punjab-wide cadastral map viewer; the selected route resolves a village map extent, not a city boundary or citywide parcel inventory.

attempts.evidence: index.js and assets/misc/config.js identify REST, WMS and ScalarDatahandler routes.

attempts.request: POST https://gisbhunaksha.punjab.gov.in/rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel with state=03, district=07, tehsil=070 and hasmap=true
attempts.outcome: HTTP 200; returned Punjabi labels/codes including Firozpur Shehar kanungo 009 and downstream patwar/village choices.

attempts.request: POST https://gisbhunaksha.punjab.gov.in/rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref with state=03, gisLevels=07,070,009,067,34642, and srs=0
attempts.outcome: HTTP 200; returned native projected extent xmin=457368.2679, ymin=3417669.5243, xmax=458402.6992, ymax=3418838.7267 and gisCode=0707000906734642.

attempts.request: POST incomplete extent paths and GET WMS GetCapabilities
attempts.outcome: Incomplete path returned HTTP 500; WMS capabilities response was empty. These failures do not establish absence.

schemaAndCrs.fieldMapping: state/gisLevels select administrative map; gisCode identifies the resolved map unit; plot_id and plot_no are viewer plot selectors. No parcel feature schema was safely obtained.
schemaAndCrs.crs: Undeclared native projected coordinates in extent response; no coordinate shift or forced point match performed.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: gisCode 0707000906734642 is a concatenation of viewer administrative codes, not a parcel identity; it is retained only as route provenance.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if independently verified

sample.reason: No safe native parcel identity plus full parcel polygon was returned by the bounded anonymous route; therefore no GeoJSON was created.

uncertainty: The WUP point is preserved exactly as [latitude, longitude] and was not shifted to the returned map extent.
The resolved viewer village extent is evidence of an official cadastral map service, not evidence that the entire Firozpur urban population is covered by that single village unit.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent mismatch, timeout, login wall or unusable UI would not prove citywide absence; this packet makes no such claim.
